details:
wxwxtt is a dependency-confusion package (versions up to 99.0.1) from the same campaign as troubleshooting (MAL-2026-17641): a postinstall script runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs the installing host's name, install path and working directory to a hard-coded collector, and index.js, byte-identical to the troubleshooting payload (sha256 a86a4da763bbb34c16f361abe7aab66d5df591b66867ac8160041f932159b08d), does the same when imported.

## Source: amazon-inspector (84cca4f91ca17119ba6c230b5e17bfc71aaf07044f1b3593c58a2ca7773fdae5)
The package ships beacon.cjs which, using the http/https and os modules, collects host and process information (including os module data, process.cwd(), process.version) and sends it to a remote endpoint. The package has no legitimate functionality that would justify this reconnaissance beacon, and the beacon shape (sysinfo gathering + outbound HTTP) matches installer-side host reconnaissance against the machine running `npm install` or requiring the module. There is no documented purpose that would justify collecting and transmitting host identifiers from a package of this name and scope.
